exposure: Indication for postnatal blood glucose screen (SGA, LGA, and GDM)
Insulin treatment for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
cohort: Newborns born between January 2017 and December 2020 in the well-baby newborn nursery of a tertiary medical center who had received blood glucose concentration monitor after birth.
finding: Insulin treatment for GDM was independently associated with neonatal hypoglycemia.
